en: Why, good day to you.
Don't be shy. Come and ask my advice.
I'm a friend to all who seek a match.
Hello,
I was just drawing up a list of ladies
who would be a perfect match for you.
Please don't call me a busybody;
do have a look. It'll be ready tomorrow.
Hello, is something the matter?
Something you can't discuss at the bureau?
We keep our clients' privacy strictly,
so please feel free to visit the bureau.
Oh, it's you.
Even I like to forget my work at home.
Please come to the bureau tomorrow.
How are you doing?
You look busy. Do take care of yourself.
Being married to your work won't do, you know.
, is something the matter?
If it's advice you want, see me at the bureau.
Why,
So good of you to come. How are things?
You've been calling at the bureau often lately.
Yet you still seem hesitant to ask for advice.
You can confide in me without a worry.
, for your sake,
I'll put my whole heart into advising you.
After all, meeting people is the key to life.
Matches this, marriage that... Tiresome fellow...
There's nothing in it for him. What a fool.
Be my servant now, and work your hardest.
Best to be rid of nuisances early...
I've only just come to London.
Thank you. Perhaps, if I get the chance.
Why not pay the bureau a visit sometime?
Hello. I'm quite well, thank you.
It's kind of you to think of me, but
for now I'm freer on my own.
It's the people we meet who shape our lives.
A good match brings color to one's life.
(Meeting me brings humans only misfortune.
I must stop him, and quickly...)
Good evening, young man.
Well, well. Look at you, a handsome fellow.
A fellow like you must be a hit with the ladies.
Good evening. Please, you're teasing me.
I'm far too busy for anything like that...
Life is long. What's your hurry?
That said, a good match must be seized fast.
Ah, forgive me. I'm Bradford.
I offer everyone counsel on marriage.
Come to me for advice whenever you like.
Ah, thank you very much.
If I ever feel so inclined, I'll call on you.
Well now, any interest in meeting someone?
Busy as you are, make time to meet people.
Good matches and true love change lives.
And so does a happy marriage. Until next time.
Hello. Excuse me, but what is this place...?
I'm still new to London...
Yes, once before.
Hello, Mr. Bradford.
<Tell me about the city>
<Tell me about the bureau>
<Not at the moment>
<A little...>
You're still too young to understand.
Ha ha ha, so the truth comes out, eh?
Care to look over a list of eligible ladies?
What d'you need? Just leave it all to me
Damn it, what's wrong with me?
Me, the fella who's never sick, feeling rotten.
Give me your orders, I'll see them done
Agh, that hurts. What's got into me?
Feels like somebody gave me a good wallop.
Hey, mornin'.
Haven't seen your face before. Just moved in?
I have come today to pay my respects.
Mighty refined for a neighbor of mine.
